echo "=== StatefulSet Status ==="

kubectl get pvc -n default -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,STATUS:.status.phase,STORAGECLASS:.spec.storageClassName,VOLUME:.spec.volumeName

kubectl get pods -n default -l app=app -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,STATUS:.status.phase,READY:.status.containerStatuses[0].ready"}
